title: Te Mea Ngaro o te Torona Tawhiti
intro: I tūtaki tētahi kuini mana nui, he kuini nō tētahi whenua tawhiti, ki tētahi wero motuhake. I whai te kuini ki te whakaatu i te mana atua me te whakaaro nui, mā te whakatū i tētahi kaupapa whakamiharo i whakahē i ngā ture o te wā me te wāhi. Ka taea e koe te whakatau i ngā taipitopito o tēnei mahi whakamiharo?
clues: I whakawhiwhia ki tētahi rangatira te mana nui, tae atu ki te whakahaere i ngā mea kāore e kitea, me te kaha hoki ki te whakahau i ngā hau.
I tae mai ngā kōrero ki tēnei rangatira mō tētahi kuīni whai rawa i karakia ki te rā, ā, ka whakatau ia ki te tono i a ia ki te kooti.
I mua i te taenga mai o te kuīni, i whakaatu te rangatira i tana hiahia ki te kawe mai i tōna torona whakahīhī mai i tōna kingitanga tawhiti.
I tuku tetahi jinn nui ki te tiki i te taonga i mua i te ara ake o te rangatira i tana kaunihera.
Heoi anō, nā te mea he mōhiotanga hōhonu tōna ki te Karaipiture Tapu, i tere ake te kimi i te mahi, ā, i roto i te kemo o te kanohi ka oti.
I tōna taenga atu, ka whakahaua e te rangatira kia whakarerekētia te taonga hei whakamātautau i te hinengaro me te tirohanga a te kuīni ina tae ia ki te whare kingi.

outcome.answer: Te Tukunga a te Kuini ki a Allah

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
